title: A battle regulation: res/battle/regulations/<n>.json
description: Regulation n of ARCID_REGULATION (a/1/0/6; Regulation in regulation.h), which PokeRegulation_Load and PokeRegulation_LoadNew (poke_regulation.c) read by number, as the Union Room, the Wi-Fi and wireless battles, the Battle Subway and Pokéstar Studios (regulation 5) do, and which tools/data/regulation_data.py packs. A field the code doesn't read keeps its C name.

name.description: The regulation's name, a message of res/text/system/load_battle_type_text_to_strbuf.txt (makeStrbufLoadBattleTypeText)

min_count.description: The fewest Pokémon a team may enter

max_count.description: The most Pokémon a team may enter

level_mode.description: How the level applies (getLevel): not at all, as the least or most level a Pokémon may have, as a cap that higher levels are set down to, as every Pokémon's level, or as the least level, which lower levels are raised to

max_level_total.description: The most that the team's levels may add up to, 0 for no limit

allow_same_species.description: Whether two Pokémon of one species may be entered

allow_same_item.description: Whether two Pokémon holding one item may be entered

banned_species.description: The species that may not be entered, a bit each (bannedSpecies, 0x52 bytes)

banned_items.description: The items that may not be held, a bit each (bannedItems, 0x4c bytes)

required_species.description: The species the team must have, SPECIES_NONE for none

launcher.description: Whether the Wonder Launcher is used: 0 not, 1 it is, 2 the players choose

unkac.description: The bits of unkAC, 7 bytes, which Regulation_CheckParamBit reads and Regulation_GetShooterSettings copies for the Wonder Launcher

allow_nicknames.description: Whether the Pokémon's nicknames are kept

show_partners.description: Whether the partners' teams are shown in the selection

battle_type.description: The battle it is for (battleType), as wifibattlematch_sys.c sets them up

max_battles.description: How many battles may be played, 0 for no limit
